title: Spooky Stretch Yoga at KOP Town Center
description: Spooky Stretch Yoga at KOP Town Center
long_description:
Join us for a relaxing evening of yoga at KOP Town Center!

About this Event

Spooky Stretch Flow 👻🕯️
Sink into a slow, eerie, feel-good stretch designed to melt tension and awaken your inner calm… with just a hint of spooky season magic.
Think spine-tingling relaxation, and a flow that feels more “boo-tiful” than scary. Perfect for unwinding, restoring, and getting in the Halloween spirit without the jump scares.
Grab your mat and water, and meet us on the green infront of Davio's! Come as you are… and leave a little more enchanted 🎃🖤

Also check out other in King of Prussia, Health & Wellness events in King of Prussia.
